title: NFL Logo Quiz Part 4: Hard Mode
headline: NFL Logo Quiz Part 4: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard NFL logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of NFL team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NFL team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

items.piece: The black and white outline around the right petal of the fleur-de-lis, with gold inside.
items.fact: The fleur-de-lis is a symbol of New Orleans. The Saints' version has stayed basically the same since the team debuted in 1967.

items.piece: A back paw of the lion, blue with a silver outline.
items.fact: In 2017 the Lions took black out of their logo, swapping the leaping lion's black outline for silver.

items.piece: The bright green around the eye, above navy and white stripes.
items.fact: The Seahawks' bird is based on a Kwakwaka'wakw transformation mask from the Pacific Northwest.

items.piece: The silver blade of one of the swords, against the red flag.
items.fact: In February 2014 the Bucs redrew the skull-and-swords flag, made its red brighter and made it much larger on the helmet.

items.piece: The Norseman's gold hair, outlined in black.
items.fact: The Vikings gave the Norseman a small update in 2013: reshaped horns, thicker face lines, a shorter braid and brighter gold.

items.piece: The top of the curling horn, blue with a white line through it.
items.fact: The Rams' LA with a curling horn debuted in 2020. A 2026 refresh made it a single color and gave the horn a sharper point.

items.piece: Orange and navy at the bear's chin, under its open mouth.
items.fact: The orange-and-navy bear head is one of the Bears' logos, but the wishbone C is the one that goes on the helmet.

items.piece: The gold and black rings at the top left edge of the oval, with red inside.
items.fact: The SF oval first appeared on the 49ers' helmets in 1962. It was restyled in 1996 and switched to a brighter red in 2009.
